data: In the middle plot, does the red line representing the 'Recursive' implementation reach the 93% accuracy level before the blue line representing the 'Iterative' implementation?

The middle plot represents the validation accuracy for the RNTN model. In this plot, the red line (representing the 'Recursive' implementation) reaches the 93% accuracy level before the blue line (representing the 'Iterative' implementation). This can be observed by comparing the positions of the two lines at approximately the same time point on the x-axis.
